column1: # Minimal issue record (P12): spec, proof, launcher, CI and migration defects until the bug ledger returns with slice 1.
# One row per issue, tab-separated. area: spec|proof|compiler|launcher|ci|migration. severity: high|medium|low.
# status: open|closed. A closed row stays; its closure condition says what closed it. Checked by check_issues.sh.

column4: P13 is approved (2026-11-05): CI runs on concrete-ci-2 plus GitHub-hosted runners as one regular pool, and the oracle is a GitHub release asset. Published 2026-11-05 with owner approval: release oracle-legacy-compiler-final on unbalancedparentheses/concrete2, its tag at the locked commit 066c9d9b8836, asset oracle-legacy-compiler-final-x86_64-linux.tar.gz downloading to artifact_sha256; ORACLE.lock artifact_url is set and scripts/oracle/fetch.sh installs and verifies it on fede-256gb. Not yet shown on a GitHub-hosted runner
column7: the tarball is published with scripts/oracle/publish.sh as release asset oracle-legacy-compiler-final-x86_64-linux.tar.gz (release_tag oracle-legacy-compiler-final), artifact_url is set to its download URL, and fetch.sh installs and verifies it on a GitHub-hosted runner

column4: required-checks.txt lists the old CI's landing tier; the new root has only the Root checks job
column7: the move commit carries the new root's required-checks.txt and a required-checks-transition.tsv row for every old job (replaced or retired with a reason), and the acceptance test passes on the moved tree

column4: the fuzz farm corpus and findings, perf history and leanprof data on concrete-ci-3 were not copied before the handover (P14)
column7: fuzzing restarts against the new compiler from tests/regressions, tests/wrong-code and generated programs (R-0272) and perf baselines are re-measured (R-0550)

column4: the owner approved taking the website down with no frozen browser bundle (P9, 2026-11-05) and it was done the same day: unbalancedparentheses.github.io/concrete2 is unpublished (Pages API DELETE, verified 404) and the `site` workflow is disabled on both repositories; on lambdaclass/concrete the Pages DELETE was refused (HTTP 422, organisation policy), so lambdaclass.github.io/concrete still serves the last deploy
column7: both site URLs return 404 (unbalancedparentheses.github.io/concrete2 and lambdaclass.github.io/concrete) and docs/archive/site-down.md records it; remaining action: a lambdaclass organisation admin unpublishes lambdaclass/concrete in Settings > Pages

column4: no workflow runs scripts/oracle/fetch.sh: the GitHub-hosted fallback path for the oracle differential is unrehearsed, and the runner-pool limits and the checks supported on a fallback runner are not written down (holistic review, P13/F15)
column7: a required oracle check runs fetch.sh then run.sh on a GitHub-hosted runner; a rehearsal shows that a missing artifact, a corrupted artifact and an install that fails verification each leave that check incomplete (blocking) rather than passed; the pool limits and the fallback-supported checks are recorded in docs/SELF_HOSTED_RUNNERS.md

column4: scripts/tests/run_tests.sh bug 282 check (a nest 20000 blocks deep resolves within 50 ms, retry 100 ms) is a wall-clock budget: on fede-256gb at load average 56 it took 60 then 127 ms and failed the acceptance check leg at aa2d10fbc; the same commit on concrete-ci-2 passed 2917/0 at 23 ms. Host contention, not a regression; the budget stays as it is
column7: wall-clock budgets in gates run only where the machine-wide heavy-run semaphore (R-0543) holds load down, or the bug 282 check measures work (a step or allocation count) instead of time; a recorded week has no load-caused failure of it

column4: the self-hosted runner services on concrete-ci-2 (gha1..gha8) have no systemd CPU or memory cap (CPUQuota and MemoryMax = infinity, measured 2026-11-05); a heavy job can starve the others on the machine
column7: each runner service (or a runner slice) carries a CPU and memory cap set from the dotfiles host file, and docs/project/SELF_HOSTED_RUNNERS.md records the values
